content.short: Ackee Blockchain is a team of auditors and white hat hackers who perform security audits and assessments.
content.description: Ackee Blockchain performs thorough security audits and assessments for Web3 companies to bolster blockchain security and verify that smart contracts and products operate correctly across all phases. The team provides education on security tools and core principles to keep code secure and products dependable before, during, and after launch. In addition, Ackee Blockchain builds open-source tooling and runs training programs such as School of Solidity and School of Solana to onboard new developers to the blockchain ecosystem.
